apple_scab.name: Apple scab
apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to dark scabby spots on leaves and fruit; leaves may yellow and drop early.
management: Rake and remove fallen leaves in autumn.
Prune for airflow and avoid overhead watering.
Ask local extension about resistant varieties.

black_rot.name: Black rot
black_rot.symptoms: Brown to black leaf spots with darker margins; fruit shrivels into hard black mummies.
management: Remove mummified fruit and infected shoots.
Improve airflow through pruning.
Clear debris from the base of plants.

cedar_apple_rust.name: Cedar apple rust
cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on leaves, sometimes with small tube-like structures underneath.
management: Remove nearby juniper/cedar galls if practical.
Choose resistant apple varieties.
Ask local extension about timing if the problem recurs yearly.

powdery_mildew.name: Powdery mildew
powdery_mildew.symptoms: White-grey powdery coating on leaves and shoots; leaves may curl or distort.
management: Increase spacing and airflow; water at the base.
Remove badly affected leaves.
Avoid excess nitrogen that promotes soft growth.

cercospora_leaf_spot_gray_leaf_spot.name: Gray leaf spot
cercospora_leaf_spot_gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Narrow rectangular tan to grey lesions running parallel to the leaf veins.
management: Rotate crops and till or bury residue.
Choose tolerant hybrids.
Avoid dense planting.

common_rust.name: Common rust
common_rust.symptoms: Small, raised reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces that release powdery spores.
management: Plant resistant hybrids.
Plant early to avoid late-season build-up.
Monitor severity before taking further action.

northern_leaf_blight.name: Northern leaf blight
northern_leaf_blight.symptoms: Long cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions on leaves.
management: Rotate crops and bury residue.
Choose resistant hybrids.
Scout fields regularly in humid weather.

esca.name: Esca (black measles)
esca.symptoms: Tiger-stripe yellow and brown patterns between veins; spotted berries; internal wood decay.
management: Remove and destroy affected wood, in dry weather.
Avoid large pruning wounds.
Seek expert advice; this is hard to manage once established.

leaf_blight.name: Leaf blight (Isariopsis leaf spot)
leaf_blight.symptoms: Irregular dark brown spots on leaves, often leading to early leaf drop.
management: Prune for airflow and remove fallen leaves.
Avoid overhead irrigation.
Keep weeds down in the row.

haunglongbing.name: Citrus greening (Huanglongbing)
haunglongbing.symptoms: Blotchy yellow mottling on leaves, lopsided bitter fruit, twig dieback.
management: Report suspected cases to your agricultural authority or extension service.
Control the Asian citrus psyllid vector as advised locally.
Do not move plant material from suspect trees.

bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot
bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small dark, water-soaked spots that turn brown, often with yellow halos; fruit may show scabby spots.
management: Use clean seed and transplants.
Avoid working among wet plants and avoid overhead watering.
Rotate away from related crops for 2-3 years.

early_blight.name: Early blight
early_blight.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings (a target pattern) starting on older leaves, often with yellow surrounds.
management: Remove lower infected leaves and mulch to stop soil splash.
Rotate crops and water at the base.
Stake and prune for airflow.

late_blight.name: Late blight
late_blight.symptoms: Large, greasy dark patches on leaves and stems, white fuzz underneath in humid conditions; rapid spread in cool, wet weather.
management: Act quickly: remove and bag infected plants.
Do not compost infected material or save tubers from affected plants.
Contact local extension; this disease spreads fast and is serious.

leaf_mold.name: Leaf mould
leaf_mold.symptoms: Pale yellow patches on upper leaf surfaces with olive-brown velvety mould underneath.
management: Lower humidity and improve ventilation (important in greenhouses).
Water at the base and avoid wet foliage.
Remove affected leaves.

septoria_leaf_spot.name: Septoria leaf spot
septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Many small circular spots with grey centres and dark margins, usually on lower leaves.
management: Remove infected lower leaves.
Mulch and water at the base.
Rotate crops and clear debris at season end.

spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_mite.name: Spider mites (two-spotted)
spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_mite.symptoms: Fine yellow stippling, bronzing and sometimes fine webbing, mostly on leaf undersides in hot dry weather.
management: Check leaf undersides with a hand lens.
Rinse plants with water and raise humidity around them.
Avoid broad-spectrum sprays that kill natural predators.

target_spot.name: Target spot
target_spot.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings and yellow halos on leaves; can also affect fruit.
management: Improve airflow and avoid overhead watering.
Remove infected leaves and debris.
Rotate crops.

tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus.name: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Upward-curling, yellowing, crinkled leaves; stunted plants with poor fruit set.
management: Control whiteflies (screens, sticky traps, removing weeds).
Remove and bag severely affected plants.
Choose tolerant varieties next season.

tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Tomato mosaic virus
tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic on leaves, distortion and stunting.
management: Remove infected plants; there is no cure.
Wash hands and disinfect tools; do not handle plants after tobacco.
Use resistant varieties and clean seed.

leaf_scorch.name: Leaf scorch
leaf_scorch.symptoms: Many small dark purple spots that enlarge, giving a scorched look as leaves dry out.
management: Remove infected leaves after harvest.
Avoid overhead watering and overcrowding.
Renovate and replace old beds.
